foundations.name: Energy
foundations.purpose: Assign semantic meaning to color and visual intensity so users can identify action, status, risk, feedback, and surface hierarchy without guessing.

roles.use: Primary route, card, configuration, recovery actions, selected controls, focus-adjacent emphasis, navigation, and links.
Completed route handoff, successful card unblock, saved permissions.
Station availability risk, limit warning, stale dashboard data.
Warning text, icon, border, and progress color on light surfaces.
Blocked route, declined movement, permission failure, destructive confirmation.
Page, card, panel, sheet, table, and map surfaces.
Separators, controls, tables, selected and focused surfaces.

foundations.name: Voice
foundations.purpose: Define typographic hierarchy and product language so content, numerals, and decisions are scannable, actionable, respectful, and consistent across mobile and desktop.

roles.use: Major page or template identity with Edenred Black.
Section titles and product hierarchy with Edenred Black.
KPIs, metrics, balances, counts, dashboard values, and prominent operational numbers with Edenred Black.
Controls, table headers, KPI labels, form labels with Ubuntu.
Body copy, guidance, explanations with Ubuntu.
Metadata, timestamps, helper text, secondary annotations.
Token names, API examples, agent-readable snippets.

foundations.name: Frame
foundations.purpose: Govern spacing, grid, density, sizing, and responsive rhythm so product surfaces feel organized and never rely on one-off layout fixes.

roles.use: Inline gaps, component gaps, section rhythm, page rhythm.
Mobile, tablet, laptop, desktop content structure.
Compact operations, default product rhythm, comfortable review/touch flows.
Controls, cards, sheets, pills, panels.
Control heights, touch targets, dashboard modules, panels.
Controls, tables, selected surfaces, dividers.

foundations.name: Depth
foundations.purpose: Define spatial hierarchy through surfaces, elevation, overlays, z-index, blur, and focus layering so users understand what is persistent, contextual, temporary, or blocking.

roles.use: Base app surface and dashboard canvas.
Cards, KPI tiles, station preview panels, table containers.
Menus, popovers, quick action clusters, map controls.
Sheets, modals, blocking review flows, permission gates.
Risk, destructive action, financial or role-change confirmations.
Transient confirmations and recovery messages.

foundations.name: Momentum
foundations.purpose: Govern motion and transition so movement communicates cause, continuity, feedback, priority, and status without becoming required comprehension.

roles.use: Risk and accessibility fallback changes that must not delay comprehension.
Hover, press, focus, button feedback, small control transitions.
Tabs, filters, small panels, selected state updates.
Sheets, route transitions, onboarding moments.
Loading indicators with reduced-motion alternative.
Replace translation/scale with opacity, focus placement, and instant state.

foundations.name: State
foundations.purpose: Define interaction states, precedence, state composition, disabled behavior, loading behavior, validation, and assistive technology mapping.

roles.use: Available, stable, unselected baseline.
Pointer affordance without changing semantic value.
Keyboard and assistive navigation location.
Momentary activation feedback.
Chosen filter, tab, option, or row.
Pending operation; duplicate activation blocked.
Unavailable because permission, data, offline, risk, or future availability blocks action.
Recoverable or blocking failure with repair path.

foundations.name: Tone
foundations.purpose: Govern product language temperature so neutral, assistive, urgent, repair, and confirmation messages are respectful, useful, and operationally clear.

roles.use: Default labels, metadata, dashboard explanations.
Guidance before action or setup.
Warnings, thresholds, time-sensitive operational risk.
Error recovery, permission failures, declined actions.
Successful save, route handoff, card state change.

foundations.name: Growth
foundations.purpose: Track maturity, adoption, telemetry, deprecation, and learning signals so artifacts evolve deliberately instead of becoming undocumented leftovers.

roles.use: New concept, early pattern, or experiment.
Shared artifact with documented examples and adoption.
Artifact with telemetry, quality signals, and known outcomes.
Artifact replaced or unsafe for new work.
Behavioral audit for critical actions and adoption.

foundations.name: Symbol
foundations.purpose: Define visual metaphors, domain symbols, illustration rules, and semantic image language without confusing them with functional iconography.
componentDependencies: Station Detail and Route Guidance pattern

roles.use: Symbolic emphasis around product action moments.
Successful or resolved operational scenes.
Cautionary scenes, not functional warnings alone.
Blocking or destructive states with content support.
Vehicles, cards, stations, routes, fleets, permissions.
Onboarding, empty, success, and teaching moments.

foundations.name: Iconography
foundations.purpose: Govern functional glyphs through Material Symbols, semantic roles, size, color, accessible names, and fallback behavior.

roles.use: Buttons, quick actions, menus, toolbar commands.
Topbar, breadcrumbs, tabs, drawers, route movement.
Success, warning, error, pending, disabled state glyphs.
Vehicle, card, driver, station, route, payment.
12, 16, 20, 24, 32px governed glyph sizes.
Meaningful icons are named; decorative icons are hidden.

foundations.name: Accessibility
foundations.purpose: Ensure every artifact preserves access through semantics, keyboard, focus, touch, contrast, reduced motion, language, localization, recovery, and fallback behavior.
componentDependencies: Station Detail and Route Guidance pattern

roles.use: Every interactive control has visible or programmatic accessible name.
Native or ARIA role matches behavior.
Expanded, selected, busy, disabled, invalid, current announced correctly.
Visible focus, order, trap, restore, skip route.
Mobile and tablet controls meet target size.
Text, controls, status, charts, maps remain readable.
Errors explain cause, next step, support path, and escalation.
